# Sell 80.00 USD of a 100.00 USD cost basis that cost 1.37 CAD/USD, leaving
# 20.00 of it. Valued at what that cost basis cost — 109.60 CAD — because a
# sale must be; what it fetched is the 110.40 on the bank, and the 0.80
# difference is the realized gain.
#
# {basis} is the cost basis split's guid, filled in by the test from the book.
2026-02-28 * "Sell 80 USD of the claim"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -80.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.37"
		value: "-109.60"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{basis}"
	Assets:Bank 110.40 CAD
	Income:FX Gain $residual$ CAD
